verdict.rationale: Polar documents an official remote MCP server (mcp.polar.sh) giving AI agents secure OAuth-based access to organization data/actions, with documented client setup for Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT, and Claude Desktop, and a probe confirms the endpoint is live and auth-gated per the MCP spec. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) hands-on usage report beyond the vendor docs and probe.
